test_title: PYST 36: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) JLN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6b9a61779db10f29c14ed2e3965d2a05cb30fc0643745349aff0453115a8c511.png] 

Option 2) ACD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f0c275ed3a056604ebc104608a03404d61580d362025717cad64e9296e12b45.png] 

Option 3) LNO

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5da118c13b30b3de7fb7a4d5aa9dc4115e15e19e46b3997eed6048ab45464e97.png] 

Option 4) TVW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e31aff7d24e70c862a9015c7e5d623bc8279548cc372f52f93ff077fe400f81d.png] 

Here, 'JLN' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
